Name: Sophia SVE Dialogue Expansion
Author: degradingwindow1
Description:
[font=Arial][size=2]I love Sophia from Stardew Valley Expanded. FlashShifter has done a great job at making this character. Her looks, personality and lifestyle are very charming to me, and she very quickly became one of my favorite characters in all of Stardew Valley. Although her dialogue is plentiful, there are many times where I feel like Sophia is a bit too repetitive in certain places. This mod aims to freshen up the Sophia experience by adding more dialogue to her in as many categories as possible. [/size][/font]
[u][color=#d5a6bd]
[/color][/u][center][b][font=Verdana][u][size=5]﻿[/size][size=5]Content[/size][/u][/font]
[/b][/center][font=Arial]
[size=2]Adds new dialogue in places where Sophia normally only has 1 dialogue such as in (All of these have both a non-marriage and marriage versions):
[/size][list]
[*][size=2]Saloon[/size]
[*][size=2]Resort[/size]
[*][size=2]Desert Festival[/size]
[*][size=2]Night Market[/size]
[*][size=2]Green Rain[/size]
[/list][size=2]
For all you fellow Sophia fans who have her as your spouse, this mod provides a lot of new dialogue for occasions such as:[/size][/font][list]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Outdoors[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Rainy Morning & Night[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Indoor Morning & Night[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Weekend Morning & Night[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Patio[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Friday Morning & Night[/size][/font]
[*][font=Arial][size=2]Kid Related [/size][/font]
[/list][size=2][font=Arial]
And there's also a whole bunch of other miscellaneous dialogue of varying categories to diversify your Sophia experience. 

Currently the mod has around 500+ dialogues overall with future updates focusing on expanding already existing pools of dialogue.

[u]Age Rating[/u]
There's flirtatious and romantic dialogue, but nothing crosses into NSFW territory. Expect it to be at around the same level as both Stardew Valley and Stardew Valley Expanded. There are also no swear words or profane language of any kind present as Sophia is a character who would never say them. 

[u]Player Gender[/u]
All dialogue in the mod is gender neutral, neither gender has more or less dialogue.

[u]Multiplayer[/u]
In the case of playing a multiplayer game, only the player who has installed the mod may receive the expanded dialogue. It is not necessary for all players to have the mod installed but it is recommended you do to avoid any potential problems.[/font]
[/size]
[color=#d5a6bd][u]
[/u][/color][size=5][center][b][u]Installation [/u][/b][/center][/size]
[font=Arial][size=3][u]Installing the Mod:[/u][/size]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Arial]Download the file "(CP) Sophia SVE Dialogue Expansion" from the Files section[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Make sure you have all the required mods[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Unzip the file inside your mods folder[/font]
[*][font=Arial]You should now see a folder called "[CP] Sophia Dialogue Expansion" sitting alongside all your other mod folders[/font]
[*][font=Arial]Open Stardew Valley and enjoy![/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3][u]Updating the Mod:[/u][/size]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Arial]Delete the old "[CP] Sophia Dialogue Expansion" folder [/font]
[*][font=Arial]Repeat the process from 'Installing the Mod' but with the new mod file. [/font]
[*][font=Arial]Open Stardew Valley and enjoy![/font]
[/list][font=Arial][size=3][u]Uninstalling the Mod:[/u][/size]
[/font][list=1]
[*][font=Arial]Delete the "[CP] Sophia Dialogue Expansion" folder from your mods folder (Since this is just a dialogue mod it doesn't affect your save file at all don't worry) [/font]
[*][font=Arial]Open Stardew Valley and enjoy![/font]
[/list][font=Verdana]
[/font][center][font=Verdana]
